input.scope: Single-frame capacity probe using official demo normalization; not frozen Track A adapter or benchmark score

pipeline: LDF predicted alpha + official RGBAD2layers (LaMa RGB/depth inpainting) + two-layer Dr.Bokeh renderer; supplied disparity
limits: Concurrent BokehMe work; not standardized efficiency.
PyTorch memory excludes some CUDA context/extension overhead.
Native demo initializes MiDaS on import but does not run it with supplied disparity.
Single-frame probe does not establish worst-case memory or freeze geometry/color protocol.

concurrency_context.existing_work: BokehMe dual candidate inference and two metric workers remained running; no process stopped
concurrency_context.limits: Short samples at different batch phases; not a whole-run utilization average. The native Dr.Bokeh probe finished before additional per-process sampling, so its measured peak is PyTorch allocated/reserved memory, not sampled nvidia-smi peak.
